theater: 潘諾尼亞盆地與西爾米烏姆

battle.name: 倫巴底-格皮德戰爭 (567年)
battle.theater: 潘諾尼亞盆地與西爾米烏姆
battle.brief: 公元五六七年，倫巴德王阿爾博因聯結潘諾尼亞阿伏爾可汗巴揚，摧毀多瑙河中游的格皮德王國：國王昆諾蒙德為阿爾博因親手所殺，首級被帶回營中。格皮德與倫巴德步兵承自晚期羅馬軍制的巨盾防線，擋得住正面騎兵衝撞，卻封不住阿伏爾馬上弓手的合圍與繞擊。

kit.name: 羅馬方陣盾
kit.history: 凸面的長方盾。羅馬的防線靠盾緣咬住盾緣，不是靠盾牌多厚。

countries: 交戰方是三股勢力的組合。倫巴德人一方的骨幹是潘諾尼亞的倫巴德人：西元五六〇年前後，一批「自由人」在奧陶河上游立腳，替奧斯特羅戈特人作戰又屢次反水，被拜占庭視為喧賓奪主的部眾；其王國採共同執政制，王阿爾博因與王奧多因兩人同治，重大決策交部族首領的氏族大會決定，軍隊分為步戰方陣與精銳騎士兩翼。格皮德人則是西元四五一之後在多瑙河中游建國的部族，核心在蒂薩河與索馬河之間，國王昆諾蒙德以分區首領分封土地，步兵為國家主力，重步兵方陣在同代戰場上以耐打著稱。潘諾尼亞阿伏爾汗國的騎兵是唯一主力，弓手與刀騎為核心；阿爾博因在五六六年與可汗巴揚一世訂約，許諾打垮格皮德之後把格皮德土地割給阿伏爾人。拜占庭帝國名義上是格皮德的盟友，實際按兵不動：皇帝查士丁二世當時正深陷薩珊戰爭，既無力亦無意馳援多瑙河上游，直到戰局明朗才出手收回西爾米烏姆，並收留格皮德首領烏斯迪巴德。
countriesEn: The opposing sides were a combination of three powers. On the Lombard side the backbone was the Lombards of Pannonia: from around 560 a band of 'free men' settled in the upper Drava valley, fought for the Ostrogoths while changing sides again and again, and were treated by Byzantium as guests who had become masters of the house; their kingdom practised a joint kingship, with King Alboin and King Audoin ruling together, and major decisions were taken by an assembly of clan leaders, the Thing; the army was divided into a foot phalanx and elite mounted wings. The Gepids were the people who founded a state on the middle Danube after AD 451, their core lying between the Tisza and the Sava, ruled by King Cunimund, who parcelled out land through zonal commanders, the eld, with infantry as the state's main strength and heavy foot formations famous on the contemporary battlefield for the way they absorbed blows. The Pannonian Avar Khaganate had cavalry as its only main arm, built around bowmen and sabre riders; in 566 Alboin concluded a treaty with Khagan Bayan I, promising him the Gepid lands once the Gepids were beaten. The Byzantine Empire was the Gepids' ally in name but in fact stood still: Emperor Justin II was in the grip of the war against Sasanian Persia and had neither the means nor the will to send help up the middle Danube, and only once the outcome had become clear did he move to recover Sirmium and take the Gepid leader Usdibad under his protection.
people: 關鍵人物集中在四個人身上。倫巴德王阿爾博因（五六五至五七四年在位）是這場戰爭的推手與勝負手：他與阿伏爾可汗巴揚一世結盟，又在會戰中親手格殺格皮德王昆諾蒙德，這位國王的頭顱被帶回營中，阿爾博因隨身攜帶，並強迫其女羅莎蒙德以父親的頭骨作飲器飲酒；保羅・戴肯《倫巴德人史》如此記述，這個細節後來成為《尼伯龍根之歌》中克琳希爾德復仇的關鍵道具。可汗巴揚一世是阿伏爾人的實際統帥，現代拜占庭史料把這場戰爭的功勞多歸於他而非倫巴德人。格皮德方面除了戰死的國王昆諾蒙德，還有烏斯迪巴德與巴杜阿里烏斯兩位首領：前者在格皮德覆亡後被拜占庭收容於西爾米烏姆，後者其後成為格皮德殘餘政權的首腦，並於五七三年起兵反抗阿伏爾人。編年史家保羅・戴肯（七二〇至七九九年）是本戰最重要的原始記錄者，但他的敘事站在倫巴德一邊；同時代的拜占庭史家梅南德爾與提奧菲拉克特・西莫卡塔留下的片段更為冷靜。羅莎蒙德則是這場戰爭最深遠的受害者。
peopleEn: Four figures dominate the war. Alboin, king of the Lombards from 565 to 574, was both its instigator and its deciding hand: he allied with the Avar khagan Bayan I, and in the course of the fighting he personally killed Gepid king Cunimund; the Gepid king's head was carried back to the camp, where Alboin kept it on his belt and forced Cunimund's daughter Rosamund to drink from her father's skull. Paul the Deacon's History of the Lombards records it in exactly these terms, and the detail later became the central prop of Kriemhild's revenge in the Nibelungenlied. Khagan Bayan I was the real commander of the Avars, and the contemporary Byzantine sources credit the war's principal role to him rather than to the Lombards. On the Gepid side, besides the slain king Cunimund stand two leaders, Usdibad and Baduarius: the first was received by the Byzantines at Sirmium after the kingdom fell, the second later headed the rump Gepid polity and rose against the Avars in 573. The chronicler Paul the Deacon, writing between 720 and 799, is the most important primary witness, though his narrative is written from the Lombard side; the fragments left by the Byzantine historians Menander and Theophylact Simocatta are far cooler. Rosamund, the daughter of the murdered king, was the deepest victim of the war.
kits: 卡面這件凸面長方巨盾，正是這場戰爭中步兵的骨架。羅馬方陣盾高約一公尺，寬約六七十公分，覆以皮革並加金屬飾片，盾面中央有凸起的金屬盾臍，重約六至八公斤；前臂伸入盾背的握把，必要時可用繃帶把手臂綁在盾上。羅馬人用它排成互相咬合的盾牆，前排承受衝力、後排推送，衝鋒時整列如牆推進。進入晚期帝國，盾形轉為橢圓形平盾，拜占庭重裝步兵即卡塔弗拉克圖斯（意為持盾者）所用的橢圓大盾，其名仍由羅馬人對方陣盾的稱呼演變而來，正承自這個盾系的譜系。格皮德與倫巴德這兩個多瑙河民族，作為晚期羅馬行省居民、雇傭兵與「自由人」成長起來，其步兵裝備與操典直接承接這套傳統：長矛在前，寬盾在側，雙刃短劍與投擲標槍在後。阿伏爾人則完全是另一套：複合反曲弓配短矢、彎刀、札甲與鱗甲、馬鐙與高鞍的輕騎，靠速度與射擊距離作戰。攻城沒有大型器械，靠封鎖渡口、截斷糧道、洗劫農莊與驅趕畜群迫使對手屈服；遷徙時牛車載家當，俘虜充作勞役。
kitsEn: The large curved rectangular shield on the card is exactly the framework of the infantry in this war. The Roman scutum stood about a metre tall and sixty to seventy centimetres wide, covered in leather with metal fittings and a raised metal boss at the centre, and weighed roughly six to eight kilograms; the forearm slid into the grip behind it, and a strap could bind the arm to the shield when it had to. Rome used it to build mutually overlapping shield walls, the front rank absorbing the shock while the rear ranks pushed, so that a column advanced like a moving wall. Through the late empire the shape shifted towards the flat oval shield, and the large oval shields of the Byzantine heavy infantry, the kataphraktoi or 'shield-bearers', were still called skoution in Greek, inherited directly from this scutum lineage. The Gepids and the Lombards, two Danubian peoples who grew out of the late Roman provinces, its mercenaries and its 'free men', carried that inheritance in their equipment and in their drills: spears in front, broad shields at the side, twin-edged short swords and throwing javelins behind. The Avars were a completely different system: composite recurved bows with short arrows, sabres, lamellar and scale armour, stirrups and high saddles, fighting with speed and shooting range. There were no large siege engines: reduction worked by sealing fords, cutting supply roads, raiding farmsteads and driving off the herds, forcing the enemy to yield rather than to be stormed; on the move, ox carts carried the households and captives were used as labour.
tactics: 這場戰爭的戰術是典型的草原騎兵撞上羅馬步兵。格皮德與倫巴德都把主力放在步兵：長矛兵結密集縱隊與方陣，前排大盾互相搭接成牆，側面由雙刃劍手與標槍手掩護，騎士在兩翼待命。防禦依托木柵、壕溝與據點，進攻則以閉合的盾牆（羅馬人稱之為龜甲陣）步步推進；這套動作正是保羅・戴肯記載的倫巴德作風，多瑙河北岸的同族在蒙斯拉克塔留斯一役正是靠閉合盾牆擋住東哥特騎兵的撞擊。阿伏爾人完全避免正面撞盾牆：他們以大隊騎兵包抄兩翼，箭雨覆蓋敵陣，待格皮德射手消耗、陣線鬆動才以刀騎近身衝殺，並用偽退把追出來的敵人拉散；同時封鎖渡口與糧道，燒毀田莊，令對方在不戰自潰。倫巴德人在五六六年與阿伏爾人訂約後主動出擊，把對方拉進自己擅長的正面決戰節奏，並在會戰中以精騎突入、斬首敵王，一舉瓦解格皮德士氣。拜占庭自始至終只做一件事：等兩敗俱傷，然後出兵收回西爾米烏姆，收編格皮德殘部。
tacticsEn: The grammar of the war was steppe cavalry colliding with Roman foot. Both the Gepids and the Lombards put their strength in infantry: spearmen in dense columns and phalanx, the large shields of the front rank overlapping into a wall, swordsmen and javelinmen covering the flanks, knights waiting on the wings. In defence they leaned on wooden palisades, ditches and strongpoints; in attack they advanced step by step behind a closed shield wall, the testudo, and that drill is exactly what Paul the Deacon attributes to the Lombards, the same people who on the Mons Lactarius turned back an Ostrogothic cavalry charge by closing their shields. The Avars avoided crashing into such a wall altogether: they enveloped both flanks with massed cavalry, rained arrows over the enemy, and only closed with sabre riders once the Gepid archers were spent and the line had loosened, using feigned retreats to pull out any pursuers; at the same time they sealed fords and supply roads and burned farmsteads, so that the enemy collapsed without a battle. The Lombards, having concluded their treaty with the Avars in 566, struck first, drew the enemy into the rhythm of the set-piece battle they knew how to fight, and broke Gepid morale by riding in with the elite and cutting down the enemy king. Byzantium did one thing throughout: waited for both sides to bleed, then moved to recover Sirmium and absorb the Gepid remnants.
data: 可查證的數字集中在年份與地理兩處。條約訂於五六六年，格皮德王國覆亡於五六七年，倫巴德人遷往義大利為五六八年，拜占庭重新控制西爾米烏姆亦在五六八年前後。地理上，格皮德王國的核心在多瑙河中游、蒂薩河與索馬河之間的潘諾尼亞盆地；戰爭最終的錨點西爾米烏姆即今塞爾維亞的斯雷姆斯卡・米特羅維察，約北緯四十五度零二分、東經十九度二十一分；阿伏爾汗國的根基在匈牙利大平原，即卡爾帕提盆地東半。兵員方面沒有可靠數字：保羅・戴肯只說格皮德一方的軍力大減，當代拜占庭史料亦僅作定性記載；唯一可用的量級參照是提奧菲拉克特・西莫卡塔記載的六三〇年拜占庭一次出動，在阿伏爾領土上俘獲三萬名格皮德人。制度上的數字則是編制的多寡：格皮德人按分區首領編組，倫巴德人按百戶長與部族首領編組，並以氏族大會決定戰與和。此外必須說明：史籍只記「五六七年」，未載月份，本卡戰鬥月份採當年戰役季節的通行編年；會戰地名亦已失傳，只能以格皮德王國全境與西爾米烏姆為座標。
dataEn: The verifiable numbers sit in the dates and in the geography. The treaty was concluded in 566, the Gepid kingdom was destroyed in 567, the Lombards' move into Italy fell in 568, and the Byzantine recovery of Sirmium came in the same stretch of years. Geographically, the core of the Gepid kingdom lay in the Pannonia basin between the Tisza, the Sava and the middle Danube; the final anchor of the war, Sirmium, is modern Sremska Mitrovica in Serbia, at roughly 45.02 degrees north and 19.21 degrees east; the Avar Khaganate was rooted in the Great Hungarian plain, the eastern half of the Carpathian basin. On numbers of troops there is nothing reliable: Paul the Deacon says only that the Gepid military strength was greatly reduced, and the contemporary Byzantine sources record the disaster in similarly qualitative terms; the one usable measure of scale comes from Theophylact Simocatta, who reports that a Byzantine sortie in 630 took 30,000 Gepids captive in Avar territory. The countable structures are those of organisation instead: the Gepids were organised in zonal commands, the elds, the Lombards in hundreds and clan leaders, with the Thing assembly deciding war and peace. One caveat must be stated: the sources record the year 567 and no month, so the month on the card follows the conventional campaigning season of that year; the site of the decisive engagement has been lost, and the only coordinates that survive are those of the Gepid realm as a whole and of Sirmium.
cause: 導火線是五六六年阿爾博因與巴揚一世那份以土地換勝利的條約。往深一層看，這場戰爭是多瑙河中游生存空間與河道航運的爭奪：格皮德王國扼住蒂薩河、索馬河與多瑙河三條水路，收取沿岸鹽、銅、穀物與羅馬舊行省的稅收，既擋住阿伏爾人向東向南擴張，也堵死倫巴德人南下義大利的路。倫巴德人當時被拜占庭帝國與阿伏爾人擠在潘諾尼亞的一角，雖替拜占庭打過仗，卻在查士丁二世即位之初被解除盟約並遭驅逐，無論地盤還是人口都沒有退路；格皮德人雖曾多次倚仗拜占庭的援軍擊退阿伏爾人，此刻卻因拜占庭深陷薩珊戰爭、抽不出兵力而孤立無援。加上格皮德王國本身分裂：國王與分區首領各據一方，烏斯迪巴德與巴杜阿里烏斯各領部眾，等到外敵真的到來，陣線便從內部裂開。於是，一場原本只需消耗與封鎖就能解決的僵局，變成了三方混戰。
causeEn: The spark was the treaty of 566 between Alboin and Bayan I, a bargain in which land was the price of victory. Beneath it lay a struggle for living space and river navigation on the middle Danube: the Gepid kingdom held the Tisza, the Sava and the Danube at once and levied salt, copper, grain and the taxes of the old Roman provinces, blocking the Avars from expanding east and south while closing the road the Lombards needed to reach Italy. The Lombards were then squeezed into a corner of Pannonia between Byzantium and the Avars; having fought for Constantinople, they had their alliance dissolved and were driven out in the first months of Justin II's reign, and they had no room to retreat in land or in numbers. The Gepids had beaten the Avars more than once with Byzantine help, but now Byzantium was locked in a war with Sasanian Persia and could detach no army at all, leaving them isolated. The Gepid state was divided besides: king and zonal commanders held separate follows, with Usdibad and Baduarius each commanding a part of the country, so that when a real enemy arrived the line split from within. A standoff that might have been settled by attrition and blockade thus turned into a three-way war.
impact: 直接後果是格皮德民族在歷史舞台上的退場。他們不再是多瑙河中游的獨立強權，土地被阿伏爾汗國吞併，剩餘人口分三路：一部加入倫巴德軍隊，日後成為入侵義大利的先鋒與倫巴德王國軍團的骨幹；一部逃往君士坦丁堡，成為帝國境內的移民；一部淪為阿伏爾汗國的臣屬，被編入游牧軍隊作前鋒與牧人。格皮德的消失讓阿伏爾人接替其位置，成為拜占庭北部的主要威脅，此後近兩百年間，色雷斯與多瑙河防線都在對付馬上弓手。對倫巴德人而言，這場戰爭最大的收穫是打開了南下的門：他們本不喜歡與新鄰居為伴，於是趁阿伏爾人還在收拾格皮德殘局時揮師亞平寧山，五六八年底抵達義大利，五六九年秋占米蘭，拉開歐洲中世紀的序幕。格皮德王族頭骨做成飲器的做法，也從日耳曼戰史一路傳到《尼伯龍根之歌》。
impactEn: The immediate effect was the Gepids' disappearance from the stage of history. They were no longer an independent power on the middle Danube; their land was swallowed by the Avar Khaganate and the survivors went three ways: some enlisted in the Lombard army and became the vanguard of the invasion of Italy and the backbone of the army of the Lombard kingdom; some fled to Constantinople and became immigrants within the empire; some were reduced to Avar subjects, enrolled in the nomadic host as skirmishers and herdsmen. In the Gepids' place the Avars became the chief northern threat to Byzantium, and for close to two centuries thereafter the Thracian and Danube frontier was organised against mounted archers. The Lombards' real prize was an open road to the south: disliking their new neighbours, they crossed the Alps while the Avars were still finishing off the Gepid remnants, reached Italy late in 568 and took Milan in the autumn of 569, opening the medieval chapter of European history. The practice of making a drinking vessel out of a Gepid king's skull passed from Germanic battle history into the Nibelungenlied.
result: 結果是格皮德王國的徹底滅亡。五六七年，倫巴德人與阿伏爾人聯手攻入格皮德國土，國王昆諾蒙德在會戰中為阿爾博因所殺，首級被帶回營地，格皮德的土地依條約歸阿伏爾人，「格皮地」成為可汗國的一部分，可汗巴揚一世坐擁從索馬河到多瑙河中游的牧地與耕地。格皮德人的軍隊被顯著削弱，主力解體：一部投降阿伏爾人，一部隨阿爾博因，餘者往西爾米烏姆逃奔。拜占庭皇帝查士丁二世趁勢出兵，恢復了對西爾米烏姆的統治，收留格皮德首領烏斯迪巴德並以他作為對付阿伏爾人的棋子，格皮德人因此沒有絕滅，而是以附庸與移民的形式延續到八世紀。功勞的分配至今仍有爭議：當代拜占庭史料把主力算在阿伏爾人頭上，後來倫巴德方面的編年史保羅・戴肯卻把倫巴德人寫成這場戰爭的主角。最終留下來的，是一場在幾乎沒有戰役細節記載的戰爭，它結束了格皮德人的國家，替阿伏爾人開了多瑙河之門，也把倫巴德人推上通往義大利的路。
resultEn: The result was the complete destruction of the Gepid kingdom. In 567 the Lombards and the Avars entered Gepid territory together; the king Cunimund was killed in the fighting by Alboin's own hand, his head was carried back to the camp, and by the terms of the treaty the Gepid land passed to the Avars: Gepidia became part of the khaganate, and Bayan I took possession of pastures and arable land from the Sava to the middle Danube. The Gepid army was significantly reduced and its cohesion broke up: some surrendered to the Avars, some followed Alboin, the rest fled west to Sirmium. Emperor Justin II moved in at once, restored Byzantine control of Sirmium, received the Gepid leader Usdibad and kept him in reserve against the Avars, so that the Gepids were not extinguished but survived as subjects and immigrants into the eighth century. The division of credit remains disputed: the contemporary Byzantine sources give the main weight to the Avars, while the later Lombard chronicle of Paul the Deacon makes the Lombards the protagonists. What survives is a war of which almost no engagement details are recorded, and it ended the Gepid state, opened the middle Danube to the Avars, and set the Lombards on the road to Italy.
